_about: The recorded sessions of the A/B demo. make-sessions.mjs turns each one into a Claude Code session file in claude-home/projects/. Each read records the text of the file in bad/ at the time of writing, as a real session would. Each session is one intent. No session has a search or a user correction, so only the context changes between runs.
